aug_rationale: Proportional to goat.pth struggle scores from attack sweep (noise=50%, pitch_up=30%, reverb=20%) — from robust.ipynb
deviations_from_asvspoof: No random crop: preprocessed .pt files are center-cropped to 48000 samples (ASVspoof used random crop during training).
No train-sample limit: ASVspoof used limit=30000; MLAAD-tiny has fewer samples, so all available balanced pairs are used.
No wandb logging: replaced by CSV + JSON for reproducibility.
Dataset source: MLAAD-tiny splits (train.json / val.json) instead of Bisher/ASVspoof_2019_LA HuggingFace dataset.
